name: Estidama Pearl Rating System — Sustainable Development
standard: Estidama Pearl Building Rating System (PBRS) v1.0
description: Validates project documentation against the Estidama Pearl Building Rating System (PBRS) mandated by Abu Dhabi Urban Planning Council (now part of DMT). All new buildings in Abu Dhabi must achieve a minimum 1 Pearl rating. Checks that credit submissions cover the seven categories: Integrated Development Process (IDP), Natural Systems (NS), Livable Buildings (LB), Precious Water (PW), Resourceful Energy (RE), Stewarding Materials (SM), and Innovating Practice (IP).
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: DMT (Department of Municipalities and Transport, Abu Dhabi)
